description: This is a rectangular rug with a distressed, abstract pattern. The pattern features a mix of earthy tones, including rust brown, beige, and grey, giving it a weathered or antique appearance. The texture appears soft and woven, suitable for adding warmth and visual interest to a floor space. The edges of the rug are neatly finished with a thin dark border. Its abstract design allows it to complement a variety of decor styles.
